responsibility: Configure-time registration fragment for the Go language in the GCC toplevel build system. It declares the language name and compiler executable (`go1`), names the target libraries and auxiliary language directories that must be built for Go (`target-libgo`, `target-libffi`, `target-libbacktrace`, `gotools`), identifies GC type-generation inputs (`go-lang.cc` and `go-c.h`), and marks the language as not built by default so the global configure logic can incorporate the Go frontend correctly.
